subject_definitions: <Picture 1> is the study desk of the bedroom seen from straight above.
<Subject 1> is the bedroom in <Picture 2>: off-white walls, the tall rainy window with a pale violet curtain at the left, the small white study desk across the bottom, the violet chair behind it, a small violet bookshelf with pastel spines at the right.

summary: [reference generation] At night, the white desktop of <Subject 1> seen from straight above, from the side of the desk where the girl sits.

retention_analysis: <Picture 1> ([Shot 1] reference): attribute_transfer - the desktop's white material, the window sill, the line and the palette carry over; the camera is turned around to the chair side of the desk, so the window lies along the right edge.
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): weak_reference - only the room's palette and line carry over.

detailed_description: 2D-animated. A modern flat-colour anime illustration with bold, clean dark outlines of even weight, bright flat cel colours and one simple step of soft lavender shading. [Shot 1] Night. The camera hangs straight above the study desk, turned so that the side where the girl sits is at the bottom of the frame. The smooth white desktop fills the frame from the left edge across to about nine tenths of the frame's width, its rounded near edge running along the bottom edge of the frame. Along the right edge of the frame, beside the desk, a narrow strip of the white window sill and the dark navy rainy window glass, a few raindrops shining on it. In the upper right corner of the desktop stands the round base of a small desk lamp, seen from above. Warm cream-white lamplight falls from the lamp across the desktop, brightest at the upper right and softening gently toward the lower left, the desktop's white reading clearly everywhere. A few small grey eraser crumbs lie near the middle of the desktop.
